independence: AHA/AAP, CPS, QCG, WHO and RCH are distinct authoring bodies, with overlapping resuscitation and cooling trials. QCG HIE and QCG resuscitation count as one group. AHA and ANZCOR/QCG share ILCOR upstream; not independent replications. No clinician sign-off.
clinical_review: Both languages and all14 dimensions reviewed against located passages. Recognition and transfer remain immediate; hospital interventions and drug risks retain conditions; birth respiratory severity is separated from evolving HIE; diet and follow-up avoid blanket protocols.

classification_evidence.method: Independent rg read of terminal codes, definitions and exclusions; old classification wording not used as a modern resuscitation algorithm.

dispute_adjudication.resolution: Current AHA2025 preterm cooling evidence controls the caution; older CPS/QCG35-week suggestions are not generalized. QCG withholds feeds during cooling while CPS permits minimal feeds; public text leaves choice to condition and local specialist protocol.

issues.resolution: AHA2025 section17 says under36 weeks no demonstrated benefit and possible harm; older suggestions are historical/conditional. No blanket early-preterm cooling recommendation.
Genuine protocol difference; individual specialist decision retained, without universal fasting or feeding instruction.
